messages:
claire_cs: Quick heads-up on FathomLabs onboarding. We're seeing elevated tail latencies on chat routes and rising token spend. Punchlist: propose low-risk perf pilot.
ajay_se: Details? numbers?
claire_cs: Avg p95 for /chat: 480ms -> spikes to 1.2s during batch windows; token spend ~30% above forecast last 48h. Customer using redwood-standard-v1 and 4096 seqs.
oliver_sre: Sounds like batching + KV cache misses. Any cache key churn?
claire_cs: yes, high prefix variance from multi-turn transcripts. Also they enable full_history on every request.
ajay_se: My suggestion: 1) propose int8 quantized variant of redwood-compact-v2 for non-critical endpoints; 2) split routing by priority: Low-prio -> compact-q8; High-prio -> standard-v1 with reserved capacity; 3) enable prefix caching for user intents.
taylor_pm: Sounds good. How do we pitch risk/rollout?
ajay_se: Canary 10% traffic for 48h, compare semantic fidelity on evals. If >1% regression, rollback. I'll add model mix routing snippet.
ajay_se: ```json
{"route":{
  "priority_rules":[
    {"match":"/summarize","models":["redwood-compact-v2-q8","redwood-standard-v1"]},
    {"match":"/respond","models":["redwood-standard-v1"]}
  ]
}}
```
claire_cs: I'll prep customer-facing note with expected savings (~22% tokens) and latency drop (~30% p95). @taylor_pm want to approve the messaging?
taylor_pm: Approved. Add explicit rollback instructions and an SLA caveat for reserved path.
oliver_sre: Also suggest insertion of a short smoke test for hallucination checks: 50 prompts from their prod set.
claire_cs: Great — I'll schedule an enablement call tomorrow 10am PT and attach eval plan + canary checklist. tagging ops-bot to create ticket.
ops-bot: Ticket created: CS-4321 — FathomLabs perf pilot (canary/int8-routing). Assigned to @ajay_se.
claire_cs: Thanks team. I'll capture customer feedback during call and post results here. :thumbsup:
